Name: MH Mod List
Author: mahsouto
Description:
[center][size=6][b]MH Mod List [/b][/size]
[size=4]Generate Beautiful, Shareable Mod Lists Automatically[/size][/center]

[b]MH Mod List [/b]is a mod that automatically generates a beautiful, responsive, and shareable HTML page with all your installed Stardew Valley mods. Perfect for sharing your mod setup with friends, showcasing your collection, or keeping track of your mod library!

Check it out: [url=https://cehero.com/SV/c7c0dae69f2bdadd9556.html]Here[/url]

[url=https://cehero.com/SV/c7c0dae69f2bdadd9556.html][img]https://i.ibb.co/dwbY8TZp/banner-My-Stardew-Valley-Mods-1759787128742.png[/img][/url]

[size=4][b]Features:[/b][/size]

[b]NexusMods Integration & Mod Information:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Automatic NexusMods Integration[/b]: Fetches mod images, descriptions, downloads, endorsements, update dates, and more
[*][b]Mod Dependencies[/b]: View all mod dependencies in an expandable list
[*][b]Configuration Files[/b]: See and download each mod's config.json directly from the HTML
[*][b]Update URLs[/b]: Access all download sources for each mod
[*][b]Farm Information[/b]: Display your current farm details (name, type, date, money, playtime)
[*][b]System Information[/b]: Display your Operating System, CPU, RAM and GPU.
[/list]

[b]User Interface & Design:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Fully Responsive[/b]: Card layout optimized for mobile devices
[*][b]Dark/Light Theme[/b]: Automatic theme switching based on user preference
[*][b]20 Color Presets[/b]: Choose from predefined color schemes (Default, Ocean, Forest, Sunset, Night, Pastel, Lavender, and more) or customize your own
[*][b]Professional Design[/b]: Modern UI with smooth animations and intuitive navigation
[*][b]Collapsible Sections[/b]: Farm info, filters, and alphabetical index can be collapsed for a cleaner view
[*][b]Alphabetical Index[/b]: Quick jump navigation to any mod with responsive layout
[*][b]Back to Top Button[/b]: Easy navigation for long mod lists
[*][b]Visit Counter[/b]: Track page views in header and footer
[/list]

[b]Search & Filter System:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Real-time Search[/b]: Find mods instantly by name, author, or description
[*][b]Multi-select Filters[/b]: Filter by categories and dependencies with search capability
[*][b]Status Filters[/b]: Filter by Downloaded, Favorites, Not Interested, or Updatable mods
[*][b]Advanced Sorting[/b]: Sort by name, dependencies, downloads, or endorsements
[*][b]Enhanced Pagination[/b]: Adjust display to 20, 50, or 100 mods per page with page counter
[*][b]Hide Options[/b]: Hide mods without URLs or images
[/list]

[b]Data Management:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Persistent Tracking[/b]: Your preferences are saved in browser's local storage
[*][b]Backup & Restore[/b]: Export and import your mod tracking data as JSON
[*][b]Cross-tab Sync[/b]: Changes sync automatically across browser tabs
[*][b]Banner Generator[/b]: Create custom banners with your mod list information
[/list]

[b]In-Game Features:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]In-Game UI[/b]: Generate your mod list with a simple button press (M key by default)
[*][b]Auto-Generate Options[/b]: Generate on game load or when returning to title screen
[*][b]FTP Upload[/b]: Automatically upload your HTML to a web server
[*][b]Generic Mod Config Menu Integration[/b]: Configure all settings in-game with color picker support
[*][b]Mod Blacklist[/b]: Exclude specific mods from the generated list with wildcard support
[/list]

[b]Multilingual Support:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]11 Languages Supported[/b]: English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese (BR), Italian, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Turkish, Chinese (Simplified), Hungarian
[*][b]Language Persistence[/b]: HTML remembers your selected language
[*][b]Dynamic Translations[/b]: Farm types, seasons, and game data translate according to selected language
[/list]

[b]Sharing & Preview:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Open Graph Meta Tags[/b]: Rich link previews when sharing on social media or messaging apps
[*][b]Custom Title & Description[/b]: Personalize your mod list metadata
[*][b]Logo Support[/b]: Add your custom logo for branding
[/list]

[size=5][b][left]How to Use[/left][/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][b]Open the UI[/b]: Press [b]M[/b] in-game (Can change in GMCM)
[*][b]Generate[/b]: Click "Generate Mod List" button
[*][b]Wait[/b]: The process may take a few minutes depending on your mod count
[*][b]View[/b]: Click "Open HTML" to see your mod list!
[/list]

[size=4][b]Configuration
[/b][/size]
Edit [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] or use Generic Mod Config Menu to customize:
[list]
[*]HTML title, description, and logo
[*]Color presets or individual color customization
[*]FTP server details for automatic uploads
[*]Farm information display options
[*]Auto-generation settings
[*]Output file location
[*]Mod blacklist patterns
[/list]
[size=4][b]
FTP Upload
[/b][/size]
Host your mod list on your own website:
[list=1]
[*]Configure FTP settings in config.json or GMCM
[*]Enable "Auto Upload On Generate"
[*]Share your live mod list URL with friends!
[/list]

[size=4][b]Mod Configuration Tracking
[/b][/size]
View and download the exact configuration of any mod:
[list]
[*]Toggle "Include Mod Configs" in settings
[*]Each mod with a config.json will have an expandable section
[*]Download individual configs for easy sharing
[/list]

[size=4][b]Mod Blacklist
[/b][/size]
Exclude specific mods from your generated list:
[list]
[*]Edit [font=Courier New]ModsBlacklist.txt[/font] in the mod folder
[*]Add mod UniqueIDs (one per line)
[*]Supports wildcards: * (any text) and ? (single character)
[*]Example: [font=Courier New]*.Testing[/font] excludes all testing mods
[/list]

[size=4][b]How to Use Manual Configuration Files[/b][/size]

The mod creates several [b].txt files[/b] in your mod folder for manual configuration. These files let you control which mods to include, set custom images, and assign categories without editing JSON files.

[b]ModsBlacklist.txt - Hide Specific Mods[/b]
[spoiler]
[b]Purpose:[/b] Exclude mods from your generated HTML list.

[b]How to use:[/b]
[list]
[*]Open [font=Courier New]Mods/HtmlModListGenerator/ModsBlacklist.txt[/font]
[*]Add one [b]Unique ID[/b] per line (from [font=Courier New]manifest.json[/font])
[*]Lines starting with [font=Courier New]#[/font] are comments (ignored)
[*]Save and regenerate your list
[/list]

[b]Example:[/b]
[code]
# Framework mods I don't want to show
Pathoschild.ContentPatcher
spacechase0.JsonAssets

# My private test mods
myusername.TestMod
[/code]

[b]Tips:[/b]
[list]
[*]Use this for SMAPI/framework mods that users don't need to see
[*]Hide personal or work-in-progress mods
[*]The mod will show how many mods were excluded in the console
[/list]
[/spoiler]

[b]ManualModImages.txt - Custom Mod Images[/b]
[spoiler]
[b]Purpose:[/b] Set custom images for mods that don't have good Nexus images or aren't from Nexus.

[b]How to use:[/b]
[list]
[*]Open [font=Courier New]Mods/MH Mod List/ManualModImages.txt[/font]
[*]Format: [font=Courier New]UniqueID|ImageURL[/font]
[*]One mod per line
[*]Lines starting with [font=Courier New]#[/font] are comments
[*]Save and regenerate your list
[/list]

[b]Example:[/b]
[code]
# Custom images for mods without Nexus pages
MyCustomMod.UniqueID|https://i.imgur.com/example123.png
AnotherMod.ID|https://example.com/image.jpg

# GitHub-hosted images
GitHubMod.ID|https://raw.githubusercontent.com/user/repo/main/banner.png
[/code]

[b]Supported formats:[/b]
[list]
[*]Direct image URLs (.png, .jpg, .gif, .webp)
[*]Must be publicly accessible (no authentication required)
[*]Recommended: Use image hosting services like Imgur or GitHub
[/list]

[b]Tips:[/b]
[list]
[*]Use 400x200px images for best results
[*]PNG or JPG work best
[*]GitHub raw URLs are reliable and free
[*]Manual images [b]override[/b] Nexus images if both exist
[/list]
[/spoiler]

[b]ManualModCategories.txt - Assign Categories[/b]
[spoiler]
[b]Purpose:[/b] Manually categorize mods that don't have Nexus categories or have wrong ones.

[b]How to use:[/b]
[list]
[*]Open [font=Courier New]Mods/MH Mod List/ManualModCategories.txt[/font]
[*]Format: [font=Courier New]UniqueID|Category1,Category2,Category3[/font]
[*]One mod per line, multiple categories separated by commas
[*]Lines starting with [font=Courier New]#[/font] are comments
[*]Save and regenerate your list
[/list]

[b]Example:[/b]
[code]
# Organize mods by functionality
MyFarmingMod.ID|Crops,Farming,Quality of Life
DecorativeMod.ID|Furniture,Buildings,Aesthetics

# Framework mods
FrameworkMod.ID|Modding Tools,Framework
[/code]

[b]Tips:[/b]
[list]
[*]Use consistent naming (capitalize properly)
[*]Categories are shown as filter buttons in the HTML
[*]Multiple categories help users find mods easier
[*]Manual categories [b]override[/b] Nexus categories
[/list]
[/spoiler]

[b]General Tips[/b]
[spoiler]
[list]
[*][b]Find Unique IDs:[/b] Check [font=Courier New]manifest.json[/font] inside each mod folder
[*][b]Comments:[/b] Use [font=Courier New]#[/font] at the start of a line to add notes
[*][b]Empty lines:[/b] Ignored, use them to organize your file
[*][b]Case sensitive:[/b] Unique IDs must match exactly
[*][b]Regenerate:[/b] Changes take effect after running [font=Courier New]generate_modlist[/font] command or using in-game menu
[*][b]Validation:[/b] Check SMAPI console for warnings about invalid entries
[/list]
[/spoiler]

[b]File Locations[/b]
[spoiler]
All three files are in:
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods/MH Mod List/
[/code]

[list]
[*][font=Courier New]ModsBlacklist.txt[/font]
[*][font=Courier New]ManualModImages.txt[/font]
[*][font=Courier New]ManualModCategories.txt[/font]
[/list]

The mod [b]auto-generates[/b] these files with examples if they don't exist.
[/spoiler]

[b]Workflow Example[/b]
[spoiler]
[b]1. First generation:[/b]
[code]> Press M in-game (or use console command)
> HTML generated with all mods[/code]

[b]2. Customize:[/b]
[code]> Edit ModsBlacklist.txt to hide framework mods
> Edit ManualModImages.txt for GitHub-exclusive mods
> Edit ManualModCategories.txt to organize content packs[/code]

[b]3. Regenerate:[/b]
[code]> Press M again
> New HTML reflects your changes
> Share your beautiful mod list! 🎉[/code]
[/spoiler]


[size=5][b]Troubleshooting[/b][/size]

[b]Q: The process seems stuck[/b]
A: NexusMods fetching can take several minutes for many mods. Check the SMAPI console for progress.

[b]Q: Some mods don't show images[/b]
A: Only mods with NexusMods URLs can fetch images. Mods without UpdateKeys will show a placeholder.

[b]Q: Auto-generate on exit doesn't work[/b]
A: This only triggers when you "Return to Title", not when closing the game completely.

[b]Q: Categories not showing[/b]
A: Categories must be manually assigned in the HTML using the dropdown menu.

[b]Q: Language not changing[/b]
A: Clear your browser cache or local storage if the HTML doesn't reflect language changes.
